name: Advanced oxidation processes (AOP)
principle: Published practice: hydroxyl radicals are generated by UV/H2O2, UV/persulfate, O3/H2O2 or photo-Fenton systems; radicals non-selectively oxidise compounds ozone alone misses; applied after conventional treatment on relatively clean matrices; licensor equipment: UV-AOP reactors (Trojan/Xylem), peroxide/persulfate dosing.

process_steps.name: Radical generation and oxidation
equipment: UV/H2O2 or UV/persulfate reactors (Trojan UV AOP)

performance.basis: published AOP performance on trace organics

gaps.reason: The IEA guide covers anaerobic digestion but not municipal wastewater process units; no agency TRL exists for most of them. Checked 2026-11-16.
